dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Gitanmaax Band reserves Ksoo-Gun-Ya 2A and Tsitsk 3 and Hagwilget Village Reserve Hagwilget 1 in the area around Hazelton. Land cover and features described on the map include the town of Hazelton, Hagwilget River [Bulkley River], Telegraph Trail, Two Mile Creek, trails to Babine and Quesnelle, and types of land, soil, and timber. Based upon the district name in the plan title, this land was originally part of Cassiar Land District. Surveyed by E.M. Skinner, 1898. [Signed by A.W. Vowell, Indian Reserve Commissioner, no date.] [Approved by F. Carter-Cotton, Chief Commissioner of Lands and Works, 24 April 1899.]
